claims.claim_text: Engineering executive leading regulated modernization, governed agentic AI platform architecture, and IP-led growth through disciplined operating models.
From that leadership mandate, designs control-plane architecture that gives agentic AI execution clear policy boundaries and traceable runtime evidence.
Against that platform foundation, productizes platform IP while expanding margins and team scale, connecting technical architecture to durable operating value.
In parallel, embeds release automation and security scanning into regulated modernization delivery paths, reinforcing dependable, secure movement from development through release.
The same platform discipline pairs human override and escalation paths with runtime proof-bundle lineage, while platform productization generated $22M in IP-led revenue.
It can carry this governed architecture and release resilience into broader platform IP growth, preserving control as operating scope expands.
